name: Bara ni Kakusareshi Verite
original_name: 薔薇に隠されしヴェリテ
source:
Liese is a servant to the Queen of Austria. As her family also works for the royalty, she's grown up barely knowing of the world outside.

But suddenly, a day comes when her fate will change... May 16. Their worst fears became true. After Marie Antoinette develops a  high fever, Liese is chosen to take the "scapegoat medicine", a secret recipe that's been transmitted from generations in the Habsburg family, and impersonate the queen until her recovery.

Due to the medicine's ability to change the appearance but not the personality or the voice, Liese will have to move to the Palais de Versailles until Marie Antoinette's recovery. Until the queen is recovered and Liese can return home, she'll spend her life in Paris.

Amidst a France on the verge of revolution, what outcome will the commotion have in Liese's life?

[Translated from the [url=http://www.otomate.jp/verite/story/]official website[/url]]
translation:
莉澤是奧地利王后的侍女。她的家族也侍奉王室，因此她幾乎不瞭解外面的世界。

然而，命運突然改變。5月16日，他們最擔心的事情成真：瑪麗．安東妮特王后突然高燒不退。莉澤被選中服用哈布斯堡家族代代相傳的「替身藥」，在王后康復前冒充她。

這種藥物能夠改變外貌，卻不會改變性格或聲音。莉澤必須搬到凡爾賽宮，直到王后痊癒、自己可以回家。在此之前，她只能在巴黎生活。

在革命一觸即發的法國，這場騷動會給莉澤的人生帶來怎樣的結局？

[譯自[url=http://www.otomate.jp/verite/story/]官方網站[/url]]
